turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It really is a great city for vegetarian food. Are you planning on doing any rock climbing with Sam after work today, or is it a rest day?

turns.text: No climbing today, Sam has some other things going on. I think I'm just going to head straight home after work and practice some guitar.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, absolutely. I'm definitely enjoying the slower pace and not having to run miles and miles after work.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: You definitely earned the rest! Well, have a wonderful evening with your guitar, Leo. Let me know if you need anything else today.
